overview: The Medford Community Preservation Committee heard presentations on several funding applications for local parks, historic preservation, and affordable housing initiatives. No formal funding votes were taken as the committee prepared to begin deliberations in November.

items.title: Condon Shell Lighting Application
items.summary: Kevin Bailey presented a $98,000 proposal to install app-controlled field and walkway lighting at the Condon Shell to accommodate evening community events.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Funding Proposal
items.summary: Aditi Moogoor and trust members presented a $250,000 request for the Medford Affordable Housing Trust to fund pre-development work, land feasibility studies, and homebuyer assistance programs.

items.title: St. Francis Church Window Restoration Application
items.summary: Cindy Watson and Reverend Timothy Hines presented a $150,000 request to replace window frames and install protective glass for stained glass windows at St. Francis Church.

items.title: Playstead Park Tennis Courts Resurfacing
items.summary: DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern presented a $526,000 application to fully resurface the cracked tennis courts at Playstead Park.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Buildings Preservation Design
items.summary: Tim McGivern requested an additional $84,550 in design funding to complete construction documents for restoring two historic buildings at Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Financial Review and Deliberation Planning
items.summary: The committee reviewed available CPA balances and established a schedule to deliberate and vote on project recommendations during upcoming November and December meetings.
